div.div: مِصْلَاةٌ A snare that is set up for birds &c.: (S, M: *) pl. مَصَالٍ. (S, M.) It is said in a trad., إِنَّ لِلشَّيْطَانِ فُخُوخًا وَمَصَالِىَ (S) or مَصَالِىَ وَفُخُوخًا i. e. [Verily to the Devil belong snares and traps] with which he catches men. (M.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
